1.w: For the music director, to be accompanied by stringed instruments; a psalm of David. When I call out, answer me, O God who vindicates me. Though I am hemmed in, you will lead me into a wide, open place. Have mercy on me and respond to my prayer.

2.w: You men, how long will you try to turn my honor into shame? How long will you love what is worthless and search for what is deceptive? (Selah)

3.w: Realize that the Lord shows the godly special favor; the Lord responds when I cry out to him.

4.w: Tremble with fear and do not sin. Meditate as you lie in bed, and repent of your ways. (Selah)

5.w: Offer the prescribed sacrifices and trust in the Lord .

6.w: Many say, “Who can show us anything good?” Smile upon us, Lord !

7.w: You make me happier than those who have abundant grain and wine.

8.w: I will lie down and sleep peacefully, for you, Lord , make me safe and secure.
